Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; keep your listing alive on its own clock; browse and join the recruitment board for your data centre; and look up party members' progression and the clears they have posted.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, a recruitment board with a Join button, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: PF Analysis no longer opens the Party Finder on its own while you play. It reads it after an hour away, when you press Refresh on your own data centre, or when you open it yourself. Alliance raids are no longer opened in the background, which ends the "Could not retrieve party recruitment information" messages. New setting: Collect Party Finder data all night. It is off for everyone after this update; turn it back on under Settings, Party Finder. The refresh button just says Refresh. Fixed an error that could stop Party Finder reads.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: DutyDM
Description: Get a Discord DM the instant your duty pops. Join the DutyDM Discord server, enter your Discord username, and the bot will message you the moment your queue is ready - with an in-game popup confirming it sent.
Punchline: Duty-pop alerts straight to your Discord DMs.
Changelog: Party-full alerts now only fire when the last seat fills while you wait (7 -> 8), and are blocked for 30 seconds after leaving a duty. Joining an already-full PF or re-forming after an instance no longer sends a redundant notification.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: AutoRezzer
Description:
Raises dead players around you, and accepts raises cast on you.

Requires Rotation Solver Reborn - add the Combat Reborn repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

One switch. Anyone in range who needs a raise gets one, Swiftcast first. In Occult Crescent it uses Occult Raise or Revive instead, which work on any job. It pauses your rotation only when a rez is genuinely about to happen, then puts it back exactly as it was. Four switches decide where it works: open world and FATEs, instanced duties, Eureka and Bozja, and the Crescent.

Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
Punchline: Raises everyone around you, and accepts your own. Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
Changelog: AutoRezzer now stands down completely in PvP - Frontline, Crystalline Conflict, Rival Wings and the Wolves' Den. Nothing sweeps, nothing swaps your job, and nothing accepts anything until you leave. Nobody can be raised in PvP, so there was never anything to gain in there, but there was plenty to lose: Frontline lets you change class at the spawn point, and the spawn point is exactly where dead players pile up waiting to respawn, so the plugin saw a field of bodies, decided an instant raise was called for, and turned you into a Red Mage mid-match - taking the damage you had done and your series progress on the class you queued as with it. This is not a setting and will not become one; the card and the server bar both say so while it is holding, so a plugin that is switched on and deliberately doing nothing still looks switched on. The "Ready to rez" line under the job name is also gone, because the Active badge beside the name already said it. The line still appears when there is something to say: a level you are synced below, a Swiftcast still on cooldown, or a job with no raise at all.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: Eureka Challenge Helper
Description:
Alpha.

Tracks the Eureka elemental challenge log while you play.

When you kill an enemy in Eureka that you get credit for, the plugin works out what it was - fire, ice, wind, earth, lightning or water aspected, a sprite, or an ashkin - and adds 1 to the matching counter, so your progress toward the weekly Elemental challenge log is always one banished glance away.

Every counter row also has a Track button. Switch it on and the plugin draws a line in the 3D view from your hitbox to every enemy that row would count, so you can find your ashkin or your fire aspected without having to target anything first. Element rows accept mobs up to two levels below you, sprites and ashkin must be your level or higher, exactly as the challenge log itself counts them.

Starting numbers: set them once in the window to match the current in-game log, use the +/- buttons, and hit the reset button when the week rolls over.

Enemy elements come from a bundled map of the four zones' enemies, and the aspect the game shows on a nameplate is picked up automatically. An enemy the plugin cannot place is not counted.
Punchline: Auto-tracks your weekly Eureka challenge log kills.

Author: NightmareXIV, kawaii, Mayo Botic
Name: OrangeJuice
Description:
Alpha.

Submarine-focused fork of AutoRetainer. Manages unlocking, levelling and profit routes for your submersibles across characters, sells submarine salvage at the Limsa vendor (needs Lifestream and vnavmesh), runs Salvage Mode on the MultiMode loop, and sends gil from your alts to a host character that runs OrangeJuice Host.
Punchline: Automatic submarine management, from the comfort of your bed.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: OrangeJuice Host
Description:
Alpha.

Runs on the client of the character that collects gil. Pairs with OrangeJuice, reports where it is standing, and accepts only the trades OrangeJuice announced. /ojh opens it, /ojh pair prints the pairing code in chat.

Author: Mayo Botic, UnknownX
Name: Extreme Clipping
Description:
Alpha.

A fork of UnknownX's NoClippy. Reduces the effects of lag on certain aspects of the game, such as weaving and statuses, and can show GCD clips. Pick the ping the animation lock simulates (0 to 100 ms, 8 ms by default) from the Overview tab; logging, dry run and encounter stats live under Settings.

/xclip opens the window. Turn off NoClippy while you use it: both change the same animation lock.
Punchline: Reduces the effects of lag on weaving and statuses, with a ping you choose.
Changelog: The plugin now goes by Extreme Clipping all the way through, not just on the outside. Nothing changes in game, and your settings and totals carry over.
